      Problem: Problem:; ```bash; _linked_Retmp="$(mktemp)"; if gh_Retry "${_linked_tmp}" api graphql \; -f owner="${{ github.repository_owner }}" \; The `gh_Retry` function is defined to take the command as `$@` (see `scripts/gh_helpers. sh` line 341 - runs `"$@"`). When called with `"${_linked_Retmp}"` as the first argument, it tries to execute the temp file path as a command, which will fail with "command not found" or "permission denied".; The temp file path gets interpreted as a command name. The `if` block handles failure by falling back to `_linked_raw='[]'`, so it fails silently - but the optimization (early population of LINKED_ISSUES_JSON) is bypassed and no linked issue context is fetched.; This is consistent with what `google_gemini-3-flash-preview` identified in pass 1.; ### Additional Observations; 1.
